==Proto-Semitic==

===Etymology===
{{etymon|sem-pro|id=knee}}
Often compared to {{cog|egy|bꜣk}} and to Cushitic forms such as {{cog|aa|gulúb}}.

===Noun===
{{sem-noun|m|g2=f}}

# [[knee]]

====Reconstruction notes====
In Common Semitic, there was a [[metathetic]] root formed, which yielded {{m|sem-pro||*ruk(u)b-at-|t=knee}} (compare Arabic {{m|ar|رُكْبَة}}), both of which had reflexes preserved in Arabic, Aramaic{{,}} and Ge'ez.
